dict.string: AirNote needs Input Monitoring to detect Caps Lock for recording and global shortcut keys (Ctrl+Cmd+V to paste, Option+1-5 for tone presets).
AirNote needs Accessibility access to paste polished text directly into other apps.
AirNote records your voice to transcribe and polish your text.
AirNote captures system audio during meetings so it can transcribe what other participants say.
AirNote uses Apple Events to paste text into other apps.
